correctness.rationale: The two involutions force equal-dimensional +-eigenspaces, and T identifies them. Isometries force an orthogonal doubling of the restricted form. Classification of finite-field symmetric, Hermitian and alternating forms proves all existence conditions; the centralizer of an ordered pair is the diagonal isometry group. Determinant images rigorously yield the specified 2 and 4 special-group orbit splits, and eight reflection generating pairs belong to each D8 subgroup. Independent enumeration over F3,F5,F7 and F9 plus exhaustive F3^4 two-plane census agreed exactly; finite cases are not substituted for the general proof.

value.rationale: Pairs with involutive lifts and commutator -I are natural projectively commuting 2-generator configurations, and they generate D8 subgroups with prescribed central involution. A complete simultaneous orbit and subgroup census over all odd finite fields and several classical group families is a natural structural classification. The Witt-sign obstruction and exact splitting into 2 or 4 special-group orbits are mathematical distinctions useful for embedded 2-subgroup enumeration, not arbitrary slices.
